name: FileTree
description: A file and folder tree built on Tree, from a list of nodes. Folders show open and closed icons, files get an icon by extension, and each row can carry a size or a status badge.

label.description: Accessible name of the tree, e.g. "Project files".

items.description: The nodes. A node with children is a folder; the id is its key and is unique across the whole tree.

onSelectionChange.description: Called with the selected node ids.

expandedKeys.description: Controlled set of open folders, by id.

onExpandedChange.description: Called when folders are opened or closed.

onAction.description: Called when a row is activated with Enter or a double-click.

keyboard: Tab moves into the tree, on one row, and out again
Up and Down arrows move between visible rows
Right arrow opens a closed folder, or moves to its first child; Left arrow closes it, or moves to its parent
Home and End jump to the first and last visible row
Enter activates the row (onAction); Space selects it when selection is on
Typing a letter jumps to the next row starting with it
requirements: Built on Tree: a named tree whose rows expose aria-level, aria-expanded (folders) and aria-selected (when selectable)
File and folder icons are decoration (aria-hidden); the name is the text of the row
A status such as modified is part of the row accessible name, not only a coloured badge, and the badge shows a letter as well as a colour
Sizes are text you supply, already formatted for your locale
Selection is shown by a filled row and aria-selected, not only colour
screenReader: Entering announces the tree name, the row, its level and position, and whether a folder is open
A row with a status is read as its name followed by the status
Opening or closing a folder announces the new state

use_when: Showing a project's files and folders
Picking a file from a hierarchy, with an optional size or change status
avoid_when: Flat file lists: use a ListBox or Table
Folders with thousands of children loaded at once
anti_patterns: Reusing the same id for two nodes
Showing the status only by colour
Using the file extension as the only way to tell what a file is
